name: Treachery
rules: This card provides – [D][D] -- When this card enters play, your faction loses 1 influence.
notes: Card is printed sideways (landscape). Card prints 'This card provides –' first, then the enters-play sentence; catalog has them in the opposite order with 'PROVIDES:'. No subtitle. Footer shows www.thespoils.com and no artist credit.

name: Underhanded Gamer
subtitle: if you pull it off, they deserve it
rules: OUTSMART -- COST – Use this only if your opponent controls more characters than you. Pay 3. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card cannot be blocked.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent controls more characters' and 'This turn, this card cannot be blocked.' (unblockable by everyone); catalog has 'an opponent' and adds 'by those players', which restricts the effect and plays differently with 3+ players. Footer shows www.thespoils.com and no artist credit.

name: Dazzling Trapezist
subtitle: and for my next trick...
rules: INSPIRE -- COST – Put a card from your hand on the top of your deck. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 1 speed.
notes: Footer shows www.thespoils.com and no artist credit.

name: Hypnotic Illusionist
subtitle: the piper will be paid
rules: HYPNOTIZE -- COST – Pay 5. Destroy this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Take control of the character if it has numeric cost X or less, where X is the number of [D] you control.
notes: Footer shows www.thespoils.com and no artist credit.

name: Cunning Disguise
subtitle: i swear i know that guy
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character loses 1 strength, 1 life, and gains COVERT. -- FLIP UP – 0 [D][D]
notes: Item badges -1 STR, -0 SPD, -1 LIFE. Footer shows www.thespoils.com and no artist credit.
